purpose: KV-first application service that assembles the customer store locator response from DB-owned store/service network tables.
businessRules: Public store locator reads are KV-first with DB fallback.
Store locator KV uses active:v2 so customer-copy cleanup does not reuse stale Redis payloads.
Cities, states, and service mode filters are derived from active DB rows, not frontend constants.
Store/service cards can represent physical stores, service desks, or opening-soon service points through the status field.
